description: We're looking for curious minds passionate about space, astronomy, science, and technology. Developers, designers, data scientists, researchers, and creative problem-solvers are welcome aboard. Skills in programming, AI/ML, data visualization, image processing, UI/UX, and scientific research are highly appreciated. No one gets left behind in space. Bring your curiosity, your skills, and maybe some extra coffee. Rocky would approve! 🪨
summary:
Cosmic Trace is an astronomical exploration platform developed by Team Tau Ceti to facilitate the analysis and comparison of real observational data from NASA's SPHEREx mission. The project aims to help explore the dynamic universe by investigating potential moving or variable celestial objects through the comparison of astronomical observations.

By combining data processing, scientific visualization, and interactive exploration, Cosmic Trace seeks to make complex astronomical datasets more accessible and easier to investigate. The platform provides an approach to examining observations, identifying interesting variations, and supporting further exploration of astronomical phenomena.

Our goal is to bridge the gap between large-scale space observations and accessible scientific analysis, encouraging curiosity, discovery, and new ways of exploring our universe through real astronomical data.
details:
Cosmic Trace is an astronomical exploration platform developed by Team Tau Ceti to make the exploration and analysis of NASA's SPHEREx mission data more accessible.

The platform focuses on exploring and comparing astronomical observations to investigate potential moving or variable celestial objects. By examining observational data and their differences, users can explore changes in the sky and identify interesting candidates for further investigation.

Our solution combines data processing, backend services, and scientific visualization to transform complex astronomical datasets into an interactive exploration experience. Its main benefit is providing a more accessible way to navigate astronomical observations, encouraging users to investigate patterns and explore the dynamic nature of the universe.

We developed Cosmic Trace using Python for data processing and analysis, alongside web technologies to build the platform and its interactive experience. The project brings together software engineering and astronomy in a practical and creative way.

One of our main considerations was making scientific information easier to explore without losing sight of the importance of data quality and scientific accuracy. We also considered accessibility, usability, and the potential for future improvements.

Our vision is to bridge the gap between astronomical data and scientific exploration, inspiring curiosity and demonstrating how open space mission data can become a starting point for discovery.
